title: Concurrent energy storage and decarbonization by metal–CO2 batteries: aqueous or non-aqueous?
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00266D, Review Article
Divyani Gupta, Jinshuo Zou, Jianfeng Mao, Zaiping Guo
Metal–CO2 batteries present an advanced energy storage system with the added advantage of CO2 utilization/conversion. This review summarizes electrolyte engineering strategies in metal–CO2 batteries to gain insights into their real-time application.
